drowned-bell.name: The Choir of the Drowned Bell
drowned-bell.about: The Choir is older than Bea: it descends from a mutual-aid vigil for the drowned, repeatedly dissolved and revived. Bea revived its present circle. There is no password or universal badge. At low-tide meetings different members sing different verses of an incomplete roll of names. The bell before the 1938 hurricane is real testimony, not proof of a prophecy. Nobody knows what causes it. A name is missing from the oldest roll; recovering it, hearing a bell, and obeying Bea are three different things. No ritual automatically kills or saves anyone. Membership and personal motives are private. The shared hymn is not a password to repeat during games.
